featureName: PowerShell Multi-Instance Port & Cross-Platform Test Suite
description: Port all multi-instance Ralph features to PowerShell 7+ for cross-platform compatibility. Create comprehensive test suites for both Bash and PowerShell implementations using Pester (PowerShell) and bash test scripts.

userStories.title: PowerShell Utility Module Extension
acceptanceCriteria: Extend RalphUtils.psm1 with multi-instance helper functions
Add Get-RalphInstanceId function generating {user}-{hostname}-{pid}-{timestamp}
Add Get-RalphShortId function returning first 8 characters
Add New-RalphInstanceDirectory function creating instances/{id}/ structure
Add Update-RalphStatus function writing status.json atomically
All functions have proper PowerShell help comments
Tests: Import-Module succeeds and functions are available
userStories.notes: Foundation module. Use $env:USERNAME, $env:COMPUTERNAME, $PID, Get-Date for ID generation.

userStories.title: PowerShell File Locking Implementation
acceptanceCriteria: Add Lock-RalphStory function using atomic directory creation
Add Unlock-RalphStory function to release locks
Add Test-RalphStoryLocked function to check lock status
Add Get-RalphStaleLocks function finding locks older than threshold
Add Clear-RalphStaleLocks function removing stale locks
Locks stored in locks/{story-id}.lock/ with owner.txt and timestamp.txt
Tests: concurrent lock attempts, only one succeeds
userStories.notes: Use New-Item -ItemType Directory for atomic creation. ErrorAction Stop on failure means lock held.

userStories.title: PowerShell PRD Atomic Updates
acceptanceCriteria: Add Lock-RalphPrd function using .NET Mutex for cross-process locking
Add Update-RalphPrd function with lock, read, modify, write, unlock pattern
Add Read-RalphPrdSafe function with shared lock for reading
Backup prd.json to prd.json.bak before each write
Validate JSON after write using ConvertFrom-Json
5-second timeout with 3 retries on lock acquisition
Tests: concurrent updates don't corrupt JSON
userStories.notes: Use [System.Threading.Mutex] for cross-process synchronization. Named mutex 'Global\RalphPrdLock'.

userStories.title: PowerShell Story Claiming
acceptanceCriteria: Add Get-RalphNextStory function finding unclaimed incomplete stories
Add Request-RalphStoryClaim function attempting lock + PRD update
Add Release-RalphStoryClaim function releasing lock + clearing claimedBy
Stories claimed by priority order (lowest first)
If no stories available, wait 30s and retry (max 5 retries)
Log claims with instance ID: [SHORT_ID] Claimed PS-XXX
Tests: two instances claim different stories
userStories.notes: Integrate locking and PRD update functions. Handle race conditions gracefully.

userStories.title: PowerShell Feature Branch Isolation
acceptanceCriteria: Add New-RalphStoryBranch function creating ralph/{short-id}/{story-id} branch
Add Merge-RalphStoryBranch function merging with --no-ff
Add Remove-RalphStoryBranch function cleaning up merged branches
Handle merge conflicts by aborting and logging error
Fetch and pull before branch operations
Tests: branch created, commits isolated, merge succeeds
userStories.notes: Use git commands via Invoke-Expression or Start-Process. Handle non-zero exit codes.

userStories.title: PowerShell Main Script Multi-Instance Update
acceptanceCriteria: Update ralph.ps1 to generate and use instance ID
Create instance directory on startup with init function
Write logs to instances/{id}/ralph.log
Write status.json with heartbeat on each iteration
Claim story before working, release on completion
Create feature branch for each story
Merge branch on story completion
Tests: ralph.ps1 creates instance directory and status.json
userStories.notes: Integrate all module functions into main loop. Maintain backward compatibility with single-instance mode.

userStories.title: PowerShell Graceful Shutdown
acceptanceCriteria: Register handler for Ctrl+C using [Console]::TreatControlCAsInput or try/finally
On shutdown: release all held story locks
On shutdown: update status.json to state=terminated
On shutdown: git stash any uncommitted changes
On shutdown: log termination summary
Tests: send termination signal, verify locks released
userStories.notes: PowerShell signal handling differs from Bash. Use try/finally for cleanup guarantee.

userStories.title: ralph-locks.ps1 Script
acceptanceCriteria: Create ralph-locks.ps1 with Get-Help documentation
Implement Show-LockStatus command displaying all locks
Implement Remove-Lock command force-releasing specific lock
Implement Remove-AllLocks command releasing all locks
Implement Clear-StaleLocks command removing old locks
Color-coded output: green=valid, yellow=stale, red=dead owner
Tests: all commands run without error
userStories.notes: Mirror bash ralph-locks.sh functionality. Use PowerShell cmdlet naming conventions.

userStories.title: ralph-cleanup.ps1 Script
acceptanceCriteria: Create ralph-cleanup.ps1 with -Dead, -Old, -All, -WhatIf parameters
Dead instances: no heartbeat > 5 minutes
Old instances: older than $env:RALPH_CLEANUP_TTL days (default 7)
Display summary of instances by state
-WhatIf shows what would be deleted without deleting
Tests: cleanup commands work correctly
userStories.notes: Use PowerShell -WhatIf pattern for dry-run. Check lastHeartbeatEpoch in status.json.

userStories.title: ralph-parallel.ps1 Script
acceptanceCriteria: Create ralph-parallel.ps1 with Start, Stop, Status commands
Start -Count N launches N instances as background jobs
Jobs tracked in instances/running-jobs.json
Stop sends graceful termination to all jobs
Status shows running job count and details
Default count = (CPU cores / 2), minimum 1
Tests: parallel launch creates multiple instances
userStories.notes: Use Start-Job for background execution. Store job IDs for management.

userStories.title: ralph-dashboard.ps1 Script
acceptanceCriteria: Create ralph-dashboard.ps1 with auto-refresh display
Show table: Instance ID | Story | Status | Iteration | Runtime
Show PRD progress bar using Unicode block characters
Color coding: green=working, yellow=idle, red=error, gray=dead
Refresh every 2 seconds (configurable with -RefreshInterval)
Exit with Q key or Ctrl+C
Tests: dashboard displays without error
userStories.notes: Use Write-Host with -ForegroundColor. Clear-Host for refresh. Read-Host -Timeout for key input.

userStories.title: Pester Test Suite - Core Functions
acceptanceCriteria: Create tests/RalphMultiInstance.Tests.ps1 using Pester 5+
Test Get-RalphInstanceId returns valid format
Test Lock-RalphStory acquires lock atomically
Test concurrent lock attempts - only one succeeds
Test Update-RalphPrd with concurrent writes
Test stale lock detection and cleanup
All tests pass: Invoke-Pester returns 0 failures
userStories.notes: Use Pester Describe/Context/It structure. Mock filesystem for isolation.

userStories.title: Pester Test Suite - Scripts
acceptanceCriteria: Create tests/RalphScripts.Tests.ps1 for script testing
Test ralph-locks.ps1 all commands
Test ralph-cleanup.ps1 with -WhatIf
Test ralph-parallel.ps1 status command
Test ralph-dashboard.ps1 --help
Test ralph.ps1 instance initialization
All tests pass with Invoke-Pester
userStories.notes: Test scripts can be invoked. Use TestDrive: for temp files.

userStories.title: Bash Test Suite - Core Functions
acceptanceCriteria: Extend tests/test-multi-instance.sh with more tests
Test flock PRD locking under concurrent writes
Test story claiming with simulated instances
Test git branch creation and merge
Test signal handling and cleanup
Test dead instance detection
All tests pass: exit code 0
userStories.notes: Use subshells to simulate concurrent instances. Check file contents after operations.

userStories.title: Bash Test Suite - Scripts
acceptanceCriteria: Create tests/test-scripts.sh for script testing
Test ralph-locks.sh all commands
Test ralph-cleanup.sh --dry-run
Test ralph-parallel.sh status
Test ralph-dashboard.sh --help
Test ralph.sh creates instance directory
All tests pass: exit code 0
userStories.notes: Integration tests for all helper scripts.

userStories.title: Cross-Platform Integration Tests
acceptanceCriteria: Create tests/test-cross-platform.ps1 runnable on any OS
Test that Bash and PowerShell create compatible lock formats
Test that Bash and PowerShell can read each other's status.json
Test that PRD updates from both are compatible
Test instance ID format is consistent
Document any platform-specific behaviors
Tests pass on Linux with both bash and pwsh
userStories.notes: Ensure implementations are interoperable. Same lock format, same JSON structure.

userStories.title: Documentation Update
acceptanceCriteria: Update docs/multi-instance.md with PowerShell commands
Add PowerShell examples alongside Bash examples
Document platform differences if any
Add troubleshooting for PowerShell-specific issues
Update README.md with cross-platform instructions
Add docs/powershell-guide.md with detailed PS instructions

compatibility.statusFormat: JSON with instanceId, shortId, state, currentStory, lastHeartbeatEpoch
compatibility.prdFormat: Existing prd.json with claimedBy field added to stories
